subject: Calibration handoff — cross-team norming & sensitive case guidance
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Carter <elise@peopleops-consulting.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@acme.io>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Calibration handoff — cross-team norming & sensitive case guidance

Team —

Thanks for making time this morning. We have a short norming session at 3pm to finalize final ratings for the Engineering organization and lock in any sensitive exceptions before HR review. Goals for today:

- Agree on consistent anchors for "Exceeds" vs "Far Exceeds" across Platform/Product/Services.
- Resolve top outlier cases (we'll review 3 cross-team exceptions).
- Capture agreed rating adjustments and owners for appeals.

Please review the attached calibration-deck-v2.pdf and populate your tab in norming-worksheet.xlsx before 2pm. Bring one representative case that shows the evidence chain (goals, 1:1 notes, peer feedback) — we will keep names limited to initials in the room.

Agenda (3pm — 4:30pm):
1) Quick anchor recalibration (10m)
2) Outlier case reviews (40m)
3) Adjustment proposals & signoff plan (25m)
4) Next steps for appeals / HR handoff (15m)

Sensitive note: one case flagged as "E.Z." (Platform IC) has cross-team feedback contradicting manager assessment. I want Elise included to advise on confidentiality and next steps.

Attachments: calibration-deck-v2.pdf, norming-worksheet.xlsx

Thanks — see you at 3.

Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Managers
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Carter <elise@peopleops-consulting.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Calibration handoff — cross-team norming & sensitive case guidance

Laura —

I'll be there. Quick heads-up based on the extract I pulled: Platform IC distribution is skewed toward the upper band this cycle; I attached rating-extract-platform.csv with per-manager means.

Suggestion: when we anchor, call out whether we're using median vs mean to gate "Far Exceeds". If teams are small, mean can be noisy. If we want to limit surprises for compensation, I'd recommend a median-first approach, then debate outliers.

Also, for E.Z., I agree we should keep details to initials in the room. If HR confirms confidentiality steps, we should defer any public-facing rating change until the appeal window closes.

Markus
Engineering Manager
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Carter <elise@peopleops-consulting.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Calibration handoff — cross-team norming & sensitive case guidance

La —

Thanks for pulling this together. I reviewed the deck and added a short note in the worksheet about cross-functional impact: Product's distribution this year leans toward stretch ratings because of resourcing differences; that will skew our cross-team comparisons if we don't normalize.

For the sensitive case (E.Z.): I want to be explicit that any change that could materially impact promotion/comp comp needs a quick sync with legal and payroll ops. Elise, can you confirm the confidentiality checklist and whether we need to file anything before making final adjustments?

A couple of practical asks for today's session:
- Let's surface the evidence (goals + peer notes) for each outlier in the drive link rather than re-uploading in thread.
- If we move someone down/up, create a short rationale paragraph so CS/comp teams can consume without manager-level context.

Attached: short-writeup-example.docx (sample rationale).

Thanks,
Maya
VP, Product Operations
maya.srinivasan@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, maya_srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Carter <elise@peopleops-consulting.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@acme.io>
Date: 2026-11-21T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Calibration handoff — cross-team norming & sensitive case guidance — outcomes and actions

Quick summary from today's run (thanks everyone for focused discussion):

Decisions made:
- Anchors: median-based thresholds adopted for "Far Exceeds" across Platform/Product/Services. We documented anchor notes in the deck (slide 4).
- Outliers: two cases adjusted (one up, one down) after consensus; E.Z. remains provisional pending HR checklist steps.
- Appeals path: managers will submit a 2-paragraph rationale for each adjusted rating; HR will triage within 5 business days.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Markus: upload the supporting evidence for the Platform outlier to the shared drive and add a 150–200 word rationale (due 2026-11-23).
- Connor: consolidate the Product/Services comparison table and confirm median thresholds used (due 2026-11-24).
- Maya: confirm with Elise whether legal review is required for E.Z. and document confidentiality checklist; escalate to HR as needed (due 2026-11-24).
- Laura: compile final summary and send formal sign-off request to execs and compensation (due 2026-11-25).

Requests: please post your uploaded artifacts into the Drive folder and add a single-line comment when complete. I need explicit signoff from Markus and Maya on any rating changes before I circulate to execs.

Related links and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-calibration (deck, worksheets, evidence folders)

If anyone sees an issue with the decisions above, reply all within 24 hours. Otherwise I'll move to formal signoff next week.

Laura Bennett
Director, Engineering Managers
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
